- 7.36 ppm (ddd, J = 8.3, 1.3, 0.5 Hz, 2H) - doublet of doublet of doublets, 2 protons

The two triplets at 2.62 and 2.77 ppm with J = 7.3 Hz suggest two CH2 groups coupled to each other (likely -CH2-CH2-).

The aromatic signals at 7.18 and 7.36 ppm showing 2H each suggest a para-disubstituted benzene ring (4 aromatic protons total).

Total protons: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8H
